test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: The Importance of Photosynthesis in the Earth’s Ecosystem
The Calvin Cycle and Carbon Fixation
The Role of Pigments in Photosynthesis

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains the process of **photosynthesis** and its significance in maintaining life on Earth.
 
• It highlights the two main stages: **light-dependent reactions** and **light-independent reactions (Calvin cycle)**.
 
• The passage emphasizes the role of photosynthesis in oxygen production and food supply for all living beings.
 
• Since the passage covers the overall importance of photosynthesis in the Earth's ecosystem, **Option 1** is the most appropriate title.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1: The Importance of Photosynthesis in the Earth’s Ecosystem**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: The Calvin Cycle and Carbon Fixation** – Incorrect, as the passage discusses more than just the Calvin cycle.
 
• **Option 3: The Role of Pigments in Photosynthesis** – Incorrect, as the passage focuses on the entire process, not just pigments.
 
• **Option 4: Photosynthesis in Algae and Bacteria** – Incorrect, as the passage covers photosynthesis in plants as well.
